title: Chloe Alpert
author: Chloe Alpert
description: Thoughts on AI, startups, and investing from an operator building at the intersection of software, services, and venture.
intro: I'm Head of Product at Hatcher+, where I lead our AI work — predictive intelligence for early-stage investing. Previously CEO and co-founder of Medinas Health (YC S18). I write about operations, AI, and venture capital.

building.name: Hatcher+
building.blurb: Head of Product. 75+ machine learning models powering 12+ predictive scores for early-stage investing.

building.name: Medinas Health
building.blurb: Founder and CEO (YC S18). Reverse logistics for hospital capital equipment. Diverted ~50,000 lbs of waste from landfills.

building.name: Mask Match
building.blurb: Co-founder. Matched 821,000 masks from 6,200 donors to 7,300 frontline healthcare workers in the first three months of COVID-19.
